implementation_contract: One independent artifact_preflight AttemptRef per exact claim; action ID differs from the training claim ID. New claim permits a new generation. Same-claim replay returns only the exact confirmed historical result.

Strict finite positive nonboolean timeout and detached command/environment/cwd before intent. Persist legacy nonsecret preflight identity plus command hash, timeout, claim and supervision metadata, not ordinary environment values or their fingerprints.

Known static configuration rejection stays in a never-prepare branch, commits NOT_STARTED with a confirmed effect and hashed receipt, and has neither TREE_CLOSED nor invented stdout/stderr hashes. Missing native config input is also configuration_error.

After READY, bind real worker identity before GO and recheck source files, admission/runtime, current attempt and claim. CPU visibility hides CUDA/HIP/ROCR and preserves NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=none; no GPU lease/start accounting.

Drain actual stdout/stderr bytes through two nonblocking caller-owned read FDs with bounded 64KiB chunks and repeated deadline checks. Both EOF and exact TREE_CLOSED are required before publication. Continuous output cannot suppress timeout checking.
STOP preserves the worker return code; STOP0/forced cleanup is not success. Unknown preparation, stop, stream EOF or closure remains HOLD, with no automatic replay or NOT_STARTED fiction.

Large file hashing and blocking process waiting are outside the effect/SQL writer. Writer uses bounded receipts/effects, stat fences and exact closure proof, then writes/readbacks/fsyncs receipt and current terminal in an owned effect transaction.
